review.scope: Five authored synthetic fixture states with pinned Arial family resolving to LiberationSans-Bold for semibold chrome, captured with Playwright 1.65.1 and Chromium 159.0.8154.6 in the CI container image. Generated headings and paragraphs now use the themed generated-view typography (large semibold heading, medium paragraph, no user-agent margins), so the complete, edited-rejected-tail and interrupted states are shorter; the completed transcript no longer overflows its scroll anchor, which leaves its leading prose visible. Idle and reset are byte-identical to the previous baseline. Each PNG was inspected against the previous baseline before retention. This is a regression baseline, not a design or accessibility qualification.
